name: sdlc
description: Marketplace for the sdlc plugin: an orchestrated, gated software lifecycle for Claude Code.

plugins.name: sdlc
plugins.description: A Claude Code harness for your SDLC: work sized to fit, Define → Build → Review → Ship, test-first proof, diff-based reviews, and a record of every change.

plugins.name: sdlc-extras
plugins.description: Optional companions to the sdlc plugin: the Ralph loop (/sdlc-extras:ralph-loop), hookify's list, configure and help commands, and the conversation-analyzer, type-design-analyzer, comment-analyzer and code-simplifier agents that /sdlc:hookify and /sdlc:review-pr use when present.

plugins.name: sdlc-stepper
plugins.description: A stepper bar above the Claude Code prompt for the active sdlc feature: Define → Build → Review → Ship, the backlog's parts, and the part and step the session is on. Claude Code only.

plugins.name: product-rebuild
plugins.description: A gated, agent-orchestrated pipeline that rebuilds an existing product end to end on top of sdlc: mining the reference, a feature matrix, slices, architecture ADRs and contracts, then each slice built through sdlc. Claude Code only; installs sdlc and sdlc-extras with it.
